title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Alts selling off: TOTAL2 -7.5% (24h) → $1.10T; TOTAL3 -10.0% (24h) → $793B. Deepening alt exodus.
TOTAL crypto market cap -3.6% (24h) → $2.68T. BTC.D +3.0% → 59.1% as BTC holds near $79K.
Oil WTI +5.1% (24h) → $91.48. Geopolitical bid persists ahead of Sep 10 ECB + Sep 11 CPI.
Liquid Network: 85% of $320M drained BTC (~3,400 BTC) returned; depeg risk receding.
FOMC Sep 16 hike odds 60% (Fed quiet period). CPI Aug Sep 11 is the swing input.
